Finite enumeration is corroboration; infinite proof is structural.

originality.rationale: The square-board 2^t formula and Ferrers nesting are explicitly prior. The new claim is the all-rectangles two-column invariant and parity bifurcation, including the opposite-parity generating function. Inspected majority dynamics literature proves eventual period behavior, not fixed-state orbit counting on these products. A directly applicable 2026 Cartesian-product majority C-coloring paper maximizes the number of colors rather than enumerating all binary equilibria. The opposite-parity integer sequence is known as OEIS A005314, but the retrieved entry supplies different objects and no rook-majority interpretation. Published result summaries on three-row rook transients and line-graph two-cycles do not imply this fixed-point theorem. Residual unindexed equivalence risk is acknowledged.
residual_risks: An older unindexed theorem may enumerate the same rectangle majority fixed classes under the language of internal partitions or Ferrers matrices.

The sequence itself occurs in OEIS A005314, and the direct OEIS page did not open, although a long indexed rendering was obtained.

value.rationale: A canonical family (line graphs of complete bipartite graphs / two-dimensional Hamming graphs) has nontrivial exact stable-opinion class diversity. A rigorous aspect-ratio invariance and a sharp dimension-parity entropy gap distinguish phase geometry in the infinite two-parameter family. A known recurrence appears in a new motivated dynamical interpretation with a direct bijective proof. The result is not a mere reindexing of the square case, which cannot imply the opposite-parity classes or n+2 invariance.
